name: leco-performance-standards
description: LECO customer service performance monitoring (Distribution Performance Standards - Commercial Quality)

scripts.setup: npm run db:up && npm -w server run db:push && npm -w server run db:seed
scripts.setup:demo: npm run db:up && npm -w server run db:push && npm -w server run db:seed -- --demo
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm -w server run build && npm -w web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w server run typecheck && npm -w web run typecheck
